title: Forge park cause v1
description: Decision 0106 ruling 1: the optional, absent-by-default `cause` object on `run/parked`, published as a numbered extension at event_schema 1 under the amended rule in contracts/README.md. One of four closed words: `ruled` (policy or engine refused, with the `rule_id` where a rule matched), `attempt-cap` (0006's cap, with the last attempt's `failure_class`), `infrastructure` (an indeterminate end, an engine restart in flight, or contention, with `retryable` true only on positive non-execution evidence), or `provider-limit` (a typed rate-limit refusal parked below the cap, with its one `refusal` variant). `unknown` is a reader's word for an absent cause and is never written. `fold` reads none of it: `reason` and `evidence` stay byte for byte, and RunState gains nothing. A present object that does not read refuses by name, never as absent.

rule_id.description: The policy rule that matched, absent exactly where no rule matched.

detail.description: The engine's own words for the refusal.

failure_class.description: The last attempt's typed failure class: a rate-limit refusal, another typed refusal, 0053's failure to start, or a determinate failure.

detail.description: 0006's cap text, with the last attempt's failure named.

retryable.description: True only under decision 0106 ruling 4: a `failed_to_start` attempt under 0053's predicate, every attempt settled and no standing writer reservation. An indeterminate attempt and a cleanly settled unanswered probe are never retryable.

detail.description: What ended the run's movement: the indeterminate close, the restart or the contention.

provider.description: The provider name the adapter's declaration uses, filled from the adapter and never parsed from prose.

detail.description: The park's own words, naming the provider's refusal and the bound it crossed.

refusal.description: One per cause decision 0103 records. The provider's words stay in the park's `reason` and in the typed `refused` record; this object never copies them.

route.description: The route the driver resolved before the host file could not be read.
The route whose earlier wait did not read.
The route whose computed wait passed the declared maximum.

until.description: The computed end the wait would have taken.

seconds.description: The computed length in whole seconds.

max_seconds.description: The declared maximum the length was judged against.
